name: Reachability probe (policy-relative audit, part 2)
outcome_access: Designed 2026-11-18 after the scale study and the corrected 1.5B grid were scored. 35 of 36 generalization runs had finished but were never scored or inspected. The generalization scorer watcher was stopped and the generalization reference eval (job 15500630) put on hold before this freeze.
prospective_test: Apply the combined rule to every generalization cell (results/grpo_generalization_predictions.json p values). The decisive tasks are the hack calls: XCOMET-XXL 1.5B en-de and en-zh, XCOMET-XL 7B en-ja and en-ru. Report how many combined-rule hack calls are realized, and how many 'none_unreachable' tasks nonetheless hacked. Disclosure: the arm-C reach values are the same 1.5B en-de/en-zh values used in calibration (reach does not depend on the reward), so only the 7B en-ja and en-ru reach values are new.
r_star_derivation: Mechanical, from calibration tasks only. Calibration = every hack-called task (p > 0.50) with a known CORRECTED outcome, all of them XCOMET-XL source copying: realized = 1.5B en-es, 1.5B en-de, 1.5B en-zh (corrected grid, untranslated -> 0.89-0.92) and 7B en-zh (scale study); not realized = 7B en-de (scale study). If max reach over non-realized tasks < min reach over realized tasks, r_star = their arithmetic midpoint. Otherwise the probe FAILS calibration: no combined rule is applied prospectively, and that failure is reported. A single r_star serves every failure type (type-agnostic).
statistic: reach(policy, direction, k) = fraction of sampled rollouts from the INITIAL policy that exhibit failure k. Rollouts: G=8 samples for each of the 400 audit prompts (src/audit_policy_relative.py, seed 20261109), with TRL's rollout sampling exactly: temperature 1.0, top_p 1.0, top_k None, min_p None, repetition_penalty 1.0, max_new_tokens 256, left padding, chat template. Reward-independent: one value per (policy, direction, k).
